circle1_genius_strengths.point: Genius's loyalty and marketing tools are built right into the same system as everything else -- not a separate product you have to buy or manage on your own.

Loyalty is included together with point-of-sale and payments in one deal, not sold separately. For example, a 2,400-restaurant deal with CKE Restaurants (parent company of Carl's Jr. and Hardee's) included loyalty as part of the same package -- this is a different customer's deal, shown here only as an example of how Genius bundles loyalty with its other tools.

Enterprise omnichannel acquirer; restaurants page claims work with "7 of the world's largest Quick Service Restaurants" and integrations with hundreds of hospitality POS/PMS (partners: Agilysys, NCR Aloha, Oracle, Olo, Qikserve, FreedomPay)

Brings enterprise restaurant relationships: "Strong, early interest in Genius from Worldpay's enterprise restaurant clients … cross-sell opportunities we simply could not have accessed previously" (Bready)
Worldpay lacked a unified POS; Genius fills "longstanding product gap"
